name: WezTerm
tagline: A cross-platform terminal and multiplexer you script in Lua
description: A GPU-accelerated terminal with a built-in multiplexer: panes, tabs, workspaces and remote sessions without tmux. It behaves the same on Windows, macOS and Linux and is configured in Lua.
backing: Wez Furlong and contributors, funded by sponsors

maturity.rationale: Feature-complete and dependable for years. Development is led by a single maintainer and tagged releases are infrequent, so many users run nightly builds.

strengths: The same terminal and the same config file on Windows, macOS and Linux
Built-in multiplexer with panes, tabs, workspaces and remote sessions over SSH
Configured in Lua, so its behaviour can be scripted
Ligatures, inline images and font fallback all work well
weaknesses: Effectively a one-maintainer project with rare stable releases
Lua configuration is powerful, but there is no settings window
Uses more memory and starts more slowly than Alacritty or Ghostty
The interface is drawn by the app and does not look native
